She stands upright with her arms resting beside her and rotates in place through one full turn. Preserve her reference proportions, clothes and hairstyle. Clear readable silhouette, clean contours, flat local colors with restrained cel shading. Fixed camera, constant character size, feet on the same spot. aesthetic score: 5.5. motion score: 3.0. There is no text in the video.
